rules.pattern: ^#? *(第[一二三四五六七八九十]+章 .*)$

notes: TOC present. Chapter headings (e.g., '# 第七章 相交线与平行线') are already level-1 headings. Section headings (e.g., '7.1 相交线') are promoted to level-2. Subsection headings (e.g., '观察与猜想 看图时的错觉') are promoted to level-3. Patterns are deterministic and preserve math, images, and code blocks.
